title: Not what I expected
text: As someone who decided to subscribe because someone else showed me their previous box, I was pretty disappointed in the box. I only received a couple full sized items and then a few samples. I personally didn’t like anything from the box besides the cute stickers. I’ll wait until the next box to see if it’s worth continuing to subscribe to. I wish there was a way to customize them even further like boxes for people with dry hair, damaged hair, colored hair, and so forth.
label: neutral
